revision_scope: Whole-document readability pass: positive precise claims; actual assumptions/protocol facts retained; scratchpad/feedback motivation added; older empirical evidence remains excluded
current_pair_identity_table: numeric and configuration table body unchanged
matched_training_loss_table: numeric table body unchanged; caption simplified
retained_display_equations: all exact canonical blocks; unrelated raw-write display deliberately excluded
retained_algorithms: all exact canonical blocks; unrelated historical protocols deliberately excluded
formal_state_channel_results: Theorem names, conditioned schedules, domains, and decoder assumptions retained; repetitive counterclaims removed
conditional_latching_theorems: Mathematical statement bodies and parameter/perturbation conditions retained; concrete production-range research question kept
other_formal_scope: S5 recognizer/lookup and adjacent E97/GDN2 core statements retained; unrelated raw-write and predecessor cost analyses removed from manuscript, proof repository untouched
historical_material: No old benchmark tables, numeric comparisons, or extended interpretations in paper or appendix; source pointers only
current_pair_qualifications: single seed; common cap/stop rule with unequal realized steps; declining length accuracy; intermediate GDN2 checkpoint; non-chance plateau; S5 OOM/curriculum caveat; no held-out LM pair or measured matched-FLOP claim
visual_review: All 30 pages inspected as contact sheets; opening, current-pair tables, formal section, and short history register inspected at larger scale
scientific_execution: No training experiments or Lean proof builds rerun; canonical scientific artifacts untouched
readability_scope: Abstract, introduction, definitions, architecture, systems, methods, results, captions, formal discussion, applications, related work, open questions, conclusion, history register
deleted_not_relocated: Imagined full-stack impossibility, universal-superiority, minimal-depth, deployment, and similar rebuttals deleted rather than moved
